SCHEDULES-
-Schedules are subject to change without notice.
ARRIVAL AT THE AIRPORTS-
-Passengers should arrive at TACA's Offices or at the
airports at the hour shown on the envelope containing the ticket, in order to have time
enough to comply with all necessary formalities prior
to departure.
Flights will not be
delayed to carry any passenger who arrives late to fill said formalities,
the Company
being free of any responsibility in these cases.
CANCELLATIONS-Passengers, that for any unexpected reason will not use their
confirmed seats, should give at least 48 hours' notice to any of our Offices prior to depar-
ture of the ship to enable us to provide same to some other interested party.
In cases
when these cancellations are made in a shorter period than 24 hours before departure
of the plane, the value of the ticket will be refunded with a 10% discount,
and when
the passenger does not show up at the airport in due time, a 25% discount will be made
The Company reserves the right to cancel any scheduled flight before take-off or
during same if it deems it advisable for safety or any other arising causes.
In all cases
the
passenger will only be refunded for the unused portion of his ticket.
FARES-(See Tariffs). A discount of 10% is granted on round or circle trip tickets,
provided the passenger buys same at the point of origin.
CHILDREN-Children under 2 years of age, not occupying a seat, may travel free
of charge, but in the company of an adult.
Two years or over and under twelve will
pay half fare.
Those who are over twelve years of age will pay full fare.
BAGGAGE-Free Weight of Baggage Allowance:
Domestic service: Adults 20 kilos.
Children paying half fare 13 kilos.
International service: Adults 30 kilos.
Children paying half fare 15 kilos.
Any EXCESS baggage will have a 1% surcharge per kilo on the one way full passage
value and it will be carried when the e is available space only.
PASSENGER INFORMATION
STOPOVERS-
-Passenger may stop over at any of the routed stations just by reques
ing it so at the time of purchasing his ticket.
from the authorities of the countries from, into or over which they intend to fly.
Company will not be responsible for the consequences of their failure to do so, and
reserves the right to deny transportation to those who are not in possession of such
documents.
For information about documents required, please get in touch with TACA's
Ticket Offices.
AIR EXPRESS SERVICE—The air express rate is equivaient to 1% over the adult
passenger fare.
EXPRESS FLIGHTS-They can be chartered and prices furnished upon request.
C. O. D. SERVICE-This service has been established to facilitate the domestic trade
all over this territory and is being widely used, at a low cost, to the entire satisfaction
of all concerned.
SCHEDULES TIME-All hours shown'on our domestic service schedules are subject
to the Venezuelan local time.
Flights are made during daylight only.
EQUIPMENT
-Douglas DC-3.
INTERNATIONAL CONNECTIONS-TACA de Venezuela keeps connections with
the following
& Southern,
Airlines:
Taca Airways Svstem.
Aerovias Brasil, Lansa,
Air
KLM,
Chicago
France, etc., which enables it to secure reservations and tickets to
passengers travelling to any point in the world served by said Airlines.
For more information about schedules,
tariffs,
etc., of the aforementioned Airlines,
please contact TACA's Ticket Offices or those of the above named ones.
OFFICIAL AIRLINE GUIDE
13!
